name: Valiant
notes: The WWC Champion of the World; retained the title against Nightstalker in the promotion's own debut broadcast (13/20 September 1997), the crowd chanting "Vengeance" for him.
caption: The WWC Champion of the World, whose crowd chants his own nickname, "Vengeance."

name: Nightstalker

identity.note: No primary-source evidence connects this WWC persona to the pre-existing nightstalker-rawf entry; a shared name in an era where the term was a common horror-adjacent gimmick word.

notes: The WWC United States Champion and #1 contender for the WWC Championship; lost the title match to Valiant in the promotion's own debut broadcast (13/20 September 1997) after being bulldogged through a table.
caption: The WWC United States Champion, unsuccessful in his own promotion's debut challenge for the World title.
